description: Known storage-rent collector/sweeper bot addresses on Ergo. Compiled from a 30-day on-chain audit (Sep 2026). All data is public blockchain data — verify on any Ergo explorer.
methodology: Addresses identified as the signed (funding) inputs in transactions that spent boxes via unsigned rent-collection. These are the operations that profit from Ergo's storage-rent confiscation branch.
